article_framing_rejections.headline: Buc-ee's at I-95 and Indrio Road Clears County Planning, Awaits State Permits

lead_independence.headline: Buc-ee's at I-95 and Indrio Road Clears County Planning, Awaits State Permits
lead_independence.lead: The proposed Buc-ee's travel center at Interstate 95 and Indrio Road in northern St. Lucie County has completed the county's planning process and now awaits final permits from the Florida Department of Transportation and the Florida Department of Environmental Protection before construction can start. The 76,000-square-foot travel center would include approximately 120 fuel pumps and could become the largest Buc-ee's location in Florida. Buc-ee's has previously targeted a 2028 opening date.

source_focus.source_title: As Buc-ee's nears construction, development interest builds in northern St. Lucie County - WPEC
source_focus.source_lead: Buc-ee’s may be best known for its massive travel centers, barbecue sandwiches and loyal fan base, but on the Treasure Coast, county leaders say the proposed development could signal something even bigger: a wave of growth along the Indrio Road corridor in northern St. After years of planning and review, the proposed Buc-ee’s at Interstate 95 and Indrio Road has completed the county’s planning process, bringing the long-discussed project one step closer to reality.
